name: whisperflow-monorepo
description: WhisperFlow — open-source, local-first AI voice dictation. Monorepo root.

scripts.build: npm run build -w packages/shared && npm run build -w packages/engine && npm run build -w apps/desktop && npm run build -w apps/website
scripts.typecheck: npm run build -w packages/shared && npm run build -w packages/engine && npm run typecheck -w packages/shared && npm run typecheck -w packages/engine && npm run typecheck -w apps/desktop && npm run typecheck -w apps/website
scripts.test: npm run build -w packages/shared && npm run test --workspaces --if-present
